diffSummary: AbortError remains an AbortError instead of becoming NETWORK_ERROR.
First bootstrap failure blocks the workspace instead of presenting an empty ledger.
Refresh failure preserves the last snapshot but locks writes until resync succeeds.
Sync errors expose an explicit retry action.
LAST SYNC now uses the last successful bootstrap timestamp.
rationale: Prevent empty or stale remote state from being mistaken for writable database truth.
